freeze_gate: deep_selection.json must bind a valid sealed 32-pair full-range discovery run; independent code/protocol review must pass; FROZEN.sha256 must not exist before both conditions
question: Under one common native signed-negation implementation, what calibrated collision-walk associations are observed across the four conductor orders f_E=1,271,120871,32756041 in the m=51 isogeny-class lattice?

claim_boundary.allowed: bounded endpoint-native lattice associations in calibrated arithmetic-mean walk_ops for the frozen implementation, selected endpoint sample, action, generator construction, seed schedule, and accounting interval

conductor_lattice.qualification: These are order-lattice adjacencies. This study has no point evaluator; discovery supplies explicit endpoint/kernel certificates only for the 32 selected P-B edges.

native_point_policy: Every curve coefficient is passed independently to setup_curve; Pgen, Ucoef, and Ust are constructed and certified natively on that curve. Each Q=kP is then constructed natively. No point, generator, walk state, or coordinate is transported between curves.

design.f271_inference_crossover: every pair uses every one of the 16 f271 orbits exactly six times
design.f271_aa_crossover: every pair uses every one of the 16 f271 orbits exactly twice
design.deep_inference_conjugates: within every pair all 51 conjugates occur once and 45 distinct conjugates occur a second time; globally counts are 60 or 61
design.deep_aa_conjugates: 32 distinct conjugates within each pair; globally counts are 20 or 21
design.f271_inference_conjugates: within each orbit/pair the six are distinct; globally each model occurs 11 or 12 times
design.f271_aa_conjugates: within each orbit/pair the two are distinct; globally each model occurs 3 or 4 times
design.pb_edge_preservation: P and B apply the same Frobenius exponent to the certified raw parent_b -> bottom_b edge; bottom_orbit_rep is population identity only

accounting.primary_interval: all online group additions and doublings after target-dependent table construction, including successful/abandoned walks, starts, look-ahead, cycle escapes, and retries
accounting.target_setup_metric: setup_ops, split into setup_adds and setup_doubles
accounting.separate_native_setup: batch_driver setup_sec and setup certificate per execution unit
accounting.separate_process_cost: worker receipt elapsed_seconds plus build/selftest elapsed_seconds
unmeasured_operation_exclusions: group-operation count for native Pgen/Ust construction and startup certification (wall seconds and invocation count are recorded)
final scalar-recovery multiplication and certificate verification
primitive weights converting field/canonicalization work to group-addition equivalents
accounting.rule: Do not combine wall time, group operations, and action primitives into one cost without a separately frozen conversion. walk_ops is not an end-to-end attack cost.

estimands.transform: x_arm=log2(calibrated arithmetic mean walk_ops); contrasts are linear functions of x
estimands.C_calibration: arithmetic mean over all 3072 inference blocks; all pairs have equal block count
estimands.A_calibration: mean of the 272 per-model arithmetic means; every f271 model has equal weight
estimands.P_calibration: mean across 32 pairs of the mean of that pair's 51 per-conjugate arithmetic means
estimands.B_calibration: mean across 32 pairs of the mean of that pair's 51 per-conjugate arithmetic means
estimands.selected_32: finite selected endpoint set: fixed crater, complete f271 census, and all conjugates of the 32 selected parent/child orbit pairs
estimands.modeled_population: conditional on the discovery keyed-modeled-PRP/exchangeability model, a pair-cluster estimand for the pilot-excluded population of 2369 parent orbits and 644368 bottom orbits; one exchangeable child orbit is observed per selected parent
estimands.whole_level_limit: one child orbit per parent leaves within-parent child heterogeneity separately unidentified; no complete named-bottom-level claim is permitted

contrast_family.method: delete-one-pair cluster jackknife standard errors and Rademacher cluster multiplier per-draw re-studentized max-absolute-T critical value
contrast_family.interpretation: All nine are endpoint/model lattice associations, not causal conductor effects. The max-T critical value is shared by the single frozen nine-contrast family.
contrast_family.equivalence_rule: A pairwise association is practically equivalent within the frozen margin only if its simultaneous 95% interval lies wholly inside [-0.10,+0.10] bits, with equality at either boundary accepted; this is not a weak-curve or security assertion.

aa_gate.family: four within-arm log2(arithmetic mean stream-B walk_ops / arithmetic mean stream-A walk_ops) contrasts
aa_gate.method: delete-one-pair cluster jackknife and a separate 100000-draw per-draw re-studentized Rademacher max-|T| family
aa_gate.pass_rule: every simultaneous 99% interval lies wholly inside [-0.15,+0.15] bits, with equality at either boundary accepted; failure invalidates endpoint inference and is reported, never repaired or backfilled

setup_robustness.trigger: after a passing A/A gate and estimable primary family, run if any of the nine primary simultaneous 95% intervals excludes zero and the corresponding absolute point estimate is at least 0.5 bit
setup_robustness.panel: 32 fixed slots: the one C model repeats in every slot; two hash-selected conjugates in each of 16 A orbits give 32 distinct A models; one hash-selected exponent applied to each certified raw P/B pair gives 32 distinct P and 32 distinct B models
setup_robustness.pairing: the same 32 fresh target scalars and walk streams, panel slots, and arm assignments repeat under all 17 setup roots; setup_seed alone changes; the primary setup root is the seventeenth descriptive bridge and is excluded from inference
setup_robustness.setup_root_sampling_model: conditional on the frozen SHA-256 derivation producing 16 distinct admissible seeds, treat those fresh seeds as an exchangeable pseudorandom sample without replacement from the valid 64-bit setup-root population; the original primary setup root is trigger-conditioned and excluded from this modeled population
setup_robustness.inference: for the 16 fresh roots only: delete-one-setup-root jackknife with all 2^16 Rademacher sign vectors, per-draw re-studentized nine-way max-|T| intervals, and a sign-symmetry multiplier reference; this is n=16 model-based/asymptotic inference, and exhaustive enumeration removes multiplier Monte Carlo error only
setup_robustness.adjusted_p_rule: exhaustively enumerated multiplier-reference adjusted p = count(max_abs_T_at_least_observed)/65536; it is not an exact finite-sample randomization p-value

persistence_rule.directional: fresh-root simultaneous CI strictly excludes zero in the primary direction
persistence_rule.practical: fresh-root simultaneous CI lies wholly at or beyond +0.5 bit for a positive primary direction or -0.5 bit for a negative primary direction

setup_robustness.bridge_rule: evaluate the original primary setup root on the identical fresh 32-slot panel, targets, and walk streams; report original-root minus fresh-root modeled estimates descriptively, with no confidence interval or p-value
setup_robustness.post_seal_recovery: if an asynchronous exception lands after an atomic primary or conditional phase seal, classify or recover that phase only after independently verifying every on-disk MANIFEST entry and bound phase artifact; a missing, malformed, or mismatched seal is never recovered
setup_robustness.artifact_contract: the deterministic 2176-row plan is validated before primary execution; after the independently sealed primary phase a write-once decision is recorded; an untriggered run has no setup_robustness subtree, while a triggered run attempts exactly one separately sealed subtree with no resume, replacement, or backfill
setup_robustness.claim_limit: the fresh-root family is conditional n=16 model-based inference under the frozen SHA-derived-root exchangeability and sign-symmetry model for this fixed 32-slot/97-model panel and fresh target/walk streams; the descriptive bridge has no inferential status; this follow-up estimand differs from the calibrated primary population estimand, so non-persistence cannot by itself identify an original-root accident; neither result establishes conductor causality, security weakness, transfer, or end-to-end advantage

failure_rules.triggered_setup_robustness_failure: primary phase remains independently sealed and valid, but the conditional lane is incomplete and must not be rerun, resumed, replaced, or backfilled
